top_issues: Mane is a comb of thin, identical shard spikes that read as splinters edge-on, including the front V bib, which looks like scattered paper triangles
The antler tines are identical cone thorns stuck along a thin, constant-section beam, a machine tell. The tines do not grow out of the beam and the crowns are weak
A heavy dark valley in the armpit and under the chest muddies the front limb close-up. The cream ears are pale plates that compete with the antlers
A.brief_fit: It has every cue: tall antlers, dark mane, rump patch, pale jaw, short tail. But the mane and tines are executed procedurally, not as bold clumps

top_issues: The antlers are short and stubby with brown, body-coloured pedicel posts. They miss 'tall branching antlers' and the forward brow tines barely read
The mane is a hollow shell with a visible rim ring at the throat (tech hero/az000). In attack_f017 it balloons into a hood over the head
The pale jaw line is a flat cream plate stuck under the jaw, and stray cream bands sit at the hind hocks
B.brief_fit: The solid mane mass, deep chest and rump patch are the most commercial-looking, but the weak antlers undercut the stag's defining cue

top_issues: The mane and bib are built from many thin shard plates, not a few bold clumps, so they read spiky and procedural in the close-ups
The ear is a thin flat cream plate that sits in front of the antler base and eye (head close-up). Two flipped faces at the throat fold when posed (purple in tech az000)
The tines have separate darker cone caps that read as glued-on pencil tips. The lower legs add an off-palette dark stocking colour
C.brief_fit: Best fit: tall, properly branching antlers with forward brow tines and crowned tips, a dark mane with a cream V bib, rump patch and short tail

stag.why: C's antlers grow and branch like a real stag's crown with forward brow tines, carrying identity where B's antlers are stubby and A's are thorned sticks, while all three share shard-built manes.

top_issues: Proportions read as a stocky pup or dog: oversized barrel chest, short thick legs, little tuck-up in hero and az000
The ruff is a few scattered small shard spikes glued on, not clumps. The cream bib has a grey window cut into it (hero, az090)
The saddle is a flat purple-grey patch pasted on the back. The tail tip is a single black needle spike, not a dark brush tip
A.brief_fit: Tall pointed ears, a good wedge face with amber eyes, and a low tail, but the long legs, tuck-up and clumped ruff cues are weak

top_issues: The ears are short blunt boxes with a dark slot, failing the 'tall pointed ears' silhouette cue. The skull has a flat boxy brow shelf
8 slivers on the body (yellow seams along the shoulder and forelimb in tech hero/az000). The ruff is a jumble of small flakes, not clumps
A dark wedge hangs between the front legs (az000). The tail brush fringe is made of small shards
B.brief_fit: Best body: long legs, deep chest, clear tuck-up, low bushy tail with a dark tip. The head and ears miss the brief

top_issues: The ruff is built from many thin triangle plates, and the hackles are a row of identical spikes along the spine (machine tell, paper-thin edge-on)
Two flipped faces fold over at the throat when posed (purple in tech hero/az000). A dark spike pendant hangs under the chest between the forelegs (az000)
The tail is dark along its whole underside rather than a dark tip. Some ruff plates cross the shoulder and forelimb line
C.brief_fit: Closest overall: wedge head, tall pointed ears, strong amber eyes, dark saddle, deep chest with tuck-up, long legs, low bushy tail

wolf.why: C is the only wolf with both a wolf's head (tall pointed ears, wedge muzzle) and a wolf's body (long legs, tuck-up); A has the head but a pup's body, and B has the body but blunt box ears.
